purpose: Final Institution backlog tranche 28: materialize five remaining Institution identities with provenance-safe dedicated dossiers (3 direct / 2 partial) while preserving State-context and source-to-entity non-propagation.
migrationRule: An Institution counts as migrated only when its ABox record points to a dedicated Institution dossier. Direct rows preserve exact repository-retained source surfaces; partial rows preserve explicit propositions and source-precision gaps. Neither category creates Claim/EvidenceItem, Material Participation, hierarchy, control, culpability or governance inheritance.
visualRule: Derived visuals encode State context and source granularity, then terminate at the Institution identity boundary. R/S/U/N context, adjudication, administration, oversight, reform or accountability activity never propagates into an entity-level outcome.
